title.en: Six-bar linkage with SolidWorks mass properties and a downward 200 N load
title.zh: 六杆机构：SolidWorks 质量属性与向下 200 N 外力

provenance.en: Prepared import, not a native browser export. Mass properties are transcribed from supplied SolidWorks screenshots; target coordinates follow the established MATLAB model.
provenance.zh: 本文件是准备好的导入模型，不是浏览器原生导出。质量属性来自用户提供的 SolidWorks 截图，目标坐标沿用已确定的 MATLAB 模型。

coordinate_frame.en: Global x right, y up; planar rotation about +z. Initial coordinates.
coordinate_frame.zh: 全局 x 向右、y 向上，绕 +z 轴作平面转动；坐标对应初始位置。

note.en: Density is shown in the screenshots; alloy grade and temper are assumptions, not established by density alone.
note.zh: 截图显示了密度；牌号和热处理状态属于选定假设，不能仅由密度确认。

H_role.en: Tracer/application point on rigid GFH beyond F in the G-to-F direction.
H_role.zh: H 为 GFH 刚体上沿 G→F 方向越过 F 的示踪点和施力点。

note.en: Steady speed after startup. One complete out-and-back cycle per input revolution; no startup or dwell allowance.
note.zh: 按电机启动后匀速计算；输入每圈完成一个往返、搬运一件，不包含启动或停留余量。

note.en: Prescribed constant force, not a payload point mass. Anchor moves with GFH; direction remains globally downward. Arrow length is visual only.
note.zh: 给定恒定外力，不是工件点质量。作用点随 GFH 移动，方向保持全局向下；箭头长度仅用于显示。

warnings.en: PMKS stores input speed as an integer (23 RPM). After reopening, re-enter 23.1481481481481 RPM.
warnings.zh: PMKS 将转速保存为整数（23 RPM）；重新打开后需输入 23.1481481481481 RPM。

warnings.en: PMKS serializes coordinates to 0.001 m. Encoded H and Q anchor coincide at (-1.715, 4.260) m; full-precision targets are recorded separately.
warnings.zh: PMKS 将坐标保存至 0.001 m；编码后的 H 与 Q 作用点均为 (-1.715, 4.260) m，高精度计算目标另列。

warnings.en: CAD screenshots display two decimal places. Additional transformed-coordinate digits do not imply extra CAD precision.
warnings.zh: CAD 截图仅显示两位小数，变换后更多小数位不代表额外的 CAD 精度。

warnings.en: Use centroidal Lzz from SolidWorks, not the bottom Izz about the CAD origin. CAD thickness z offset is not a planar PMKS coordinate.
warnings.zh: 使用 SolidWorks 质心处 Lzz，不使用最下方绕 CAD 原点的 Izz；厚度方向 z 偏移不是 PMKS 平面坐标。

warnings.en: Changing joint geometry can recalculate CoMs. Re-enter affected custom CoMs last. If H changes, keep Q's anchor coincident with H.
warnings.zh: 修改关节几何可能重算质心，应最后重填受影响的自定义质心；若 H 改变，需保持 Q 的作用点与 H 重合。

warnings.en: CAD DCE is straight, while initial C is approximately 5.49 mm off the D-E line. CoM mapping follows the D-to-E axis as in MATLAB.
warnings.zh: CAD 中 DCE 为直杆，而初始 C 偏离 D-E 直线约 5.49 mm；质心按 MATLAB 中 D→E 轴转换。

warnings.en: Use positive magnitude +200 N and signed Y component -200 N. Current PMKS source clamps a negative magnitude to zero.
warnings.zh: 力的大小输入 +200 N，Y 分量输入 -200 N；当前 PMKS 源码会将负大小截为零。

import_note: Preserve the supplied record order. Reordering DCE before EF can produce missing second-loop kinematics and incorrect dynamic forces in PMKS+ 2.0.3.
